mapper.select: SELECT id,product_id AS productId,quantity,status FROM inventory_reservations WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,product_id AS productId,quantity,status FROM inventory_reservations WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_movements m LEFT JOIN inventory_reservations r ON r.order_id=m.order_id AND r.product_id=m.product_id AND r.quantity=m.quantity WHERE m.order_id=#{orderId} AND m.movement_type='RESERVED' AND r.id IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT NOT AND COUNT(*) > 0 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('COMMITTED','REFUNDED') AND committed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) FROM inventory_reservations WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status='COMMITTED',committed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), released_at=CASE WHEN #{fromStatus}='RELEASED' THEN NULL ELSE released_at END, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{fromStatus}
UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status='RELEASED',released_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status='REFUNDED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='COMMITTED'
mapper.sql: SELECT product_id AS id,stock_available AS stockAvailable, stock_reserved AS stockReserved,stock_sold AS stockSold FROM product_inventory WHERE product_id=#{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT catalog_business_version FROM product_inventory WHERE product_id=#{productId}
